title.zh-CN: 鼻内镜术后眼睑肿胀迅速加重
title.en: Rapidly worsening eyelid swelling after sinus surgery

summary.zh-CN: 鼻窦手术后单侧眼部肿胀逐日加重，视功能开始受损，需要识别不能等待的变化。
summary.en: Unilateral swelling worsens over successive days after sinus surgery and begins to compromise vision.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

guidelines: AAO EyeNet orbital-compartment syndrome clinical review, checked 2026-10-28; scope urgent trained decompression when clinically indicated and avoiding imaging delay. This is a clinical review, not a claimed new guideline edition.

question.zh-CN: 这次做了什么鼻部手术？

answer.zh-CN: 局麻下鼻内镜鼻窦手术及息肉切除，右上颌窦有脓性分泌物，术后水囊填塞。
answer.en: Endoscopic sinus surgery and polypectomy under local anaesthesia found right maxillary pus; balloon packing was placed.

answer.zh-CN: 右眼睑轻度肿胀，视力仍正常。

answer.zh-CN: 上午肿胀至不能睁眼，当时视力未明显下降并已取出水囊；下午出现突眼、局部热和视力0.01。
answer.en: Morning swelling prevented eye opening without obvious visual loss, and packing was removed; by afternoon proptosis, local heat and visual acuity 0.01 were recorded.

finding.zh-CN: 右眼睑红肿、眼球突出、眼眶压力增高，视力降至0.01；未给确切眼压或相对传入性瞳孔障碍检查。
finding.en: Right eyelid erythema/swelling, proptosis and increased orbital pressure with acuity 0.01; exact pressure and relative afferent pupillary-defect testing were not supplied.

text.zh-CN: 右眼睑和外侧眶软组织肿胀，筛窦致密，纸样板完整，内侧眶壁附近约1 cm软组织影，未见球后血肿。
text.en: Right eyelid/lateral orbital swelling, opaque ethmoid sinus, intact lamina papyracea and roughly 1 cm medial-orbital soft tissue; no retrobulbar haematoma.

text.zh-CN: 术后第三天已失明并头痛恶心，内镜眼眶减压时眶脂肪暗紫、突出；源文另有手压眼球操作，仅作为历史事实，绝不作为教学操作。
text.en: By postoperative day three blindness, headache and nausea had developed. Endoscopic decompression found dusky protruding orbital fat. The source also describes manual globe pressure; this remains historical documentation and is not a teaching manoeuvre.

text.zh-CN: 减压后立即恢复数指视力，后记录视力0.5及1.0；残留眼睑波动处超声提示脓肿，抽出脓液3 mL，随后视力1.5、肿胀消退。原报告换用抗菌药并给予大剂量激素，方案仅供历史复盘。
text.en: Finger-counting vision returned immediately after decompression, later acuity was 0.5 then 1.0. Persistent fluctuant eyelid swelling was an ultrasound-confirmed abscess yielding 3 mL pus; later acuity was 1.5 and swelling resolved. Changed antibiotics and high-dose steroids are reported historical care only.

prompt.zh-CN: 视力下降并突眼时，哪项判断最重要？
prompt.en: Which judgement matters most with declining vision and proptosis?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 考虑威胁视神经灌注的眼眶压力急症并立即请求眼科与耳鼻喉协作
text.en: Suspect a vision-threatening orbital pressure emergency and obtain immediate ophthalmology/ENT involvement

feedback.zh-CN: 完整纸样板与无血肿不能排除危险的压力升高。
feedback.en: An intact wall and absent haematoma do not exclude dangerous pressure elevation.

text.zh-CN: 骨壁完整即可排除眼眶并发症
text.en: An intact bony wall excludes orbital complications

feedback.zh-CN: 感染和压力损害并不都需要可见骨折。
feedback.en: Infection and pressure injury do not require a visible fracture.

text.zh-CN: 所有术后眼肿都观察到失明再处理
text.en: Observe all postoperative swelling until blindness occurs

feedback.zh-CN: 视力下降已经是紧急信号。
feedback.en: Declining vision is already an emergency signal.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 紧张眼眶与术中异常支持严重眶内过程，感染途径和病原仍未确证
text.en: The tense orbit and operative abnormalities support a serious orbital process, but route and organism remain unproven

feedback.zh-CN: CT不能证明某一次注射或隐匿小骨折是唯一原因。
feedback.en: CT does not establish a particular injection or occult fracture as the sole cause.

text.zh-CN: 已有脓液就能指定细菌种类
text.en: Pus alone identifies the bacterial species

text.zh-CN: 患者后续可能恢复便证明等待安全
text.en: Possible later recovery proves waiting is safe

feedback.zh-CN: 个案恢复不能抵消延误导致不可逆视损害的风险。
feedback.en: Recovery in one patient cannot negate irreversible visual risk from delay.

prompt.zh-CN: 现在应采用怎样的安全策略？
prompt.en: What is the safe strategy now?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 临床威胁视力时立即由熟练团队减压评估与感染处理，不为等待影像而延误
text.en: When vision is clinically threatened, arrange immediate trained decompression assessment and infection management without delaying for imaging

feedback.zh-CN: 治疗取决于实际解剖和病情；不复制手压眼球或旧文固定超大剂量激素。
feedback.en: Care depends on anatomy and severity; do not copy globe compression or historical fixed very-high steroid doses.

text.zh-CN: 让学习者按压眼球试图降低压力
text.en: Have the learner press on the globe to lower pressure

feedback.zh-CN: 这不是安全的模拟操作，可能加重眼损伤。
feedback.en: This is not a safe simulated manoeuvre and may worsen injury.

text.zh-CN: 无论视力怎样都等重复CT后再请会诊
text.en: Always wait for repeat CT before consultation regardless of vision

feedback.zh-CN: 明显视功能威胁不应被影像等待拖延。
feedback.en: Clear visual threat must not be delayed by imaging.

text.zh-CN: 查清首发症状与病程
text.en: Establish presenting symptoms and course

text.zh-CN: 补充伴随症状及相关病史
text.en: Elicit associated symptoms and relevant background

text.zh-CN: 明确过敏资料的证据边界

text.zh-CN: 核对与当前表现相关的体征
text.en: Review signs relevant to the presentation

text.zh-CN: 调阅早期关键检查
text.en: Review the key early investigations

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确整合早期证据
text.en: Integrate the early evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 核对后续验证资料
text.en: Review subsequent corroborating evidence

text.zh-CN: 首次正确说明后续证据的强度和边界
text.en: State the strength and limits of subsequent evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 识别视力威胁并及时专科处置，避免影像等待与眼球按压
text.en: Recognise visual threat and obtain timely specialist care, avoiding imaging delay and globe pressure

text.zh-CN: 复盘原报告治疗及转归
text.en: Review reported treatment and outcome

text.zh-CN: 清楚说明证据与不确定性
text.en: Explain evidence and uncertainty clearly

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明视功能趋势比单一骨壁影像更能提示紧迫性。；承认缺少准确眼压、瞳孔传入检查和微生物培养；传播机制不确定。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that The visual trend establishes urgency beyond a single bony-wall image.; acknowledge Exact pressure, afferent pupil testing and microbiological culture are absent; spread mechanism is uncertain. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告为鼻窦术后眼眶感染及压力升高伴失明，经减压与后续脓肿处理恢复视力。
conclusion.en: The source describes postoperative orbital infection and elevated pressure with blindness, followed by visual recovery after decompression and abscess management.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 视功能趋势比单一骨壁影像更能提示紧迫性。
keyReasoning.en: The visual trend establishes urgency beyond a single bony-wall image.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 无球后血肿不等于无压力急症。
keyReasoning.en: Absent retrobulbar haematoma does not exclude a pressure emergency.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 病原和传播途径未由源文证实。
keyReasoning.en: The source does not establish the organism or route.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 旧文处理延迟不应成为新教学等待策略。
teachingPoints.en: Historical delay must not become a new teaching waiting strategy.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 既往手术的眼眶风险需主动复查。
teachingPoints.en: Orbital risk after surgery requires active reassessment.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 病历中的危险操作不自动转为可执行动作。
teachingPoints.en: A hazardous documented manoeuvre is not automatically an executable action.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 缺少准确眼压、瞳孔传入检查和微生物培养；传播机制不确定。
unknowns.en: Exact pressure, afferent pupil testing and microbiological culture are absent; spread mechanism is uncertain.
